nodes.statement: A fresh install never enables cloud STT or telemetry.
nodes.ears: WHEN the local store is created, THE SYSTEM SHALL set cloud_mode to off and telemetry to off.

nodes.statement: Engine fallback never selects cloud unless the user enabled it.
nodes.ears: WHEN the selected engine is unavailable, THE SYSTEM SHALL fall back only to a ready local engine.

nodes.statement: Recording cannot start until the disclosure is acknowledged.
nodes.ears: WHEN recorder.start runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL require consent_state acknowledged.

nodes.statement: Finalized audio on disk is ciphertext, not a WAV.
nodes.ears: WHEN audio is finalized, THE SYSTEM SHALL write a file whose first bytes are not RIFF/WAVE.

nodes.statement: Stored transcript text is locally searchable.
nodes.ears: WHEN a transcript is stored, THE SYSTEM SHALL return it from search.query for a distinctive term.

nodes.statement: Delete-all removes sessions, FTS rows, and audio files.
nodes.ears: WHEN delete_all runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL make prior transcript text unsearchable.

nodes.statement: Golden fixtures are content-addressed.
nodes.ears: WHEN fixtures are validated, THE SYSTEM SHALL verify SHA-256 digests against harness/graph/fixture-lock.json.

nodes.statement: Sine capture produces a valid 16 kHz mono WAV.
nodes.ears: WHEN record_sine runs for a positive duration, THE SYSTEM SHALL return RIFF/WAVE PCM bytes.

nodes.statement: Paused PCM is not part of duration.
nodes.ears: WHEN a ChunkedRecorder is paused, THE SYSTEM SHALL ignore PCM until resume.

nodes.statement: Flushed chunks are recoverable if stop never runs.
nodes.ears: WHEN ChunkedRecorder is dropped after flush, THE SYSTEM SHALL recover a valid WAV.

nodes.statement: Demo path stays fixture and offline after live capture lands.
nodes.ears: WHEN demo_pipeline runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL use fixture-replay and zero network_calls.

nodes.statement: Missing system-audio backend is a recoverable error, not a cloud fallback.
nodes.ears: WHEN start_live(System) has no tap, THE SYSTEM SHALL return CAPTURE_UNSUPPORTED.

nodes.statement: Whisper without local weights is ENGINE_NOT_INSTALLED, never cloud or silent fixture.
nodes.ears: WHEN transcribe_local runs for whisper-large-v3-turbo without weights, THE SYSTEM SHALL return ENGINE_NOT_INSTALLED.

nodes.statement: Demo path never downloads model weights.
nodes.ears: WHEN demo_pipeline runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep network_calls at 0 and SHALL NOT write Whisper weights.

nodes.statement: A present weights file is consulted locally; invalid ggml is not a network fetch.
nodes.ears: WHEN whisper_weights_path exists but is not a valid model, THE SYSTEM SHALL return ENGINE_MODEL_INVALID.

nodes.statement: A model payload that fails SHA-256 is rejected and not kept on disk.
nodes.ears: WHEN install_bytes sees a digest mismatch, THE SYSTEM SHALL return CHECKSUM_MISMATCH and SHALL NOT leave weights.

nodes.statement: Parakeet is a local file plus overlay, never cloud, never silent fixture.
nodes.ears: WHEN Parakeet weights are missing, THE SYSTEM SHALL return ENGINE_NOT_INSTALLED; WHEN they are checksum-valid, overlay SHALL be ready.

nodes.statement: Notes are derived locally from the transcript, never a cloud LLM.
nodes.ears: WHEN extract_notes runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep distinctive transcript claims in the notes.

nodes.statement: Export writes markdown to a local path.
nodes.ears: WHEN export_markdown_file runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL write a file containing the transcript.

nodes.statement: Privacy settings default to telemetry off and cloud off.
nodes.ears: WHEN privacy_settings is read on a fresh store, THE SYSTEM SHALL report telemetry off and cloud_mode off.

nodes.statement: Search date range returns only sessions created inside the inclusive bounds.
nodes.ears: WHEN search_filtered is given created_from and created_to, THE SYSTEM SHALL omit sessions outside that range.

nodes.statement: Tags persist locally and can filter search.
nodes.ears: WHEN set_tags runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL return the same tags from list_tags and from tag search.

nodes.statement: Master key is 32 bytes in Keychain on macOS or a 0600 file elsewhere.
nodes.ears: WHEN the store opens, THE SYSTEM SHALL persist the master key via KeyStore and reuse it on reopen.

nodes.statement: Positive retention_days deletes older sessions and their audio.
nodes.ears: WHEN apply_retention runs with retention_days > 0, THE SYSTEM SHALL delete sessions older than that window.

nodes.statement: Title substring filter works without an FTS query.
nodes.ears: WHEN search_filtered is given only title, THE SYSTEM SHALL return matching sessions.

nodes.statement: Live finalize encrypts chunk WAV, never CONSULT-001.
nodes.ears: WHEN finalize_live runs on a ChunkedRecorder, THE SYSTEM SHALL encrypt that WAV and SHALL NOT substitute the golden fixture.

nodes.statement: fixture-replay refuses audio that is not CONSULT-001.
nodes.ears: WHEN transcribe_local uses fixture-replay on non-golden WAV, THE SYSTEM SHALL return FIXTURE_AUDIO_MISMATCH.

nodes.statement: HUD LED is on while recording and off while paused.
nodes.ears: WHEN hud_from_status is given recording, THE SYSTEM SHALL set led_on. WHEN paused, THE SYSTEM SHALL set paused and not led_on.

nodes.statement: Login item backend is smappservice on macOS and unsupported elsewhere.
nodes.ears: WHEN login_item_backend runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL report smappservice on macOS and unsupported otherwise.

nodes.statement: Empty hotkey strings are rejected.
nodes.ears: WHEN parse_hotkey is given empty input, THE SYSTEM SHALL return HOTKEY_INVALID.

nodes.statement: Hotkey mode is toggle or ptt only.
nodes.ears: WHEN parse_hotkey_mode is given toggle or ptt, THE SYSTEM SHALL accept it and reject other values.

nodes.statement: Local process names classify Zoom, Teams, and Slack without starting capture.
nodes.ears: WHEN classify_processes is given Zoom, Teams, or Slack names, THE SYSTEM SHALL return those kinds and SHALL NOT start recording.

nodes.statement: Meeting detect asks; it never silent-starts.
nodes.ears: WHEN a meeting app is classified, THE SYSTEM SHALL only recommend a prompt and SHALL still require consent before capture.

nodes.statement: System-audio tap status is platform-honest.
nodes.ears: WHEN system_tap_status runs off macOS, THE SYSTEM SHALL return unsupported. WHEN on macOS, THE SYSTEM SHALL return unsupported, needs-permission, or available.

nodes.statement: System capture never fakes CONSULT-001.
nodes.ears: WHEN start_live(System) cannot capture, THE SYSTEM SHALL return CAPTURE_UNSUPPORTED recoverable. WHEN it can, THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT write CONSULT-001 bytes.

nodes.statement: Mixed capture never silently becomes microphone-only.
nodes.ears: WHEN start_live(Mixed) cannot open both sources, THE SYSTEM SHALL return MIXED_UNAVAILABLE or CAPTURE_UNSUPPORTED recoverable. WHEN system_tap_status is not available, Mixed SHALL fail.

nodes.statement: mix_pcm averages both lanes and never returns CONSULT-001.
nodes.ears: WHEN mix_pcm runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL return saturating-averaged PCM padded with silence, not fixture bytes.

nodes.statement: Parakeet runtime status is honest about whether a decoder is compiled in.
nodes.ears: WHEN parakeet_runtime_status runs without a compiled decoder, THE SYSTEM SHALL return not-built. WHEN a decoder is compiled in, THE SYSTEM SHALL return ready.

nodes.statement: Parakeet transcription never replays CONSULT-001.
nodes.ears: WHEN transcribe_local runs for parakeet with local weights, THE SYSTEM SHALL return a Parakeet transcript that is not the golden fixture, or ENGINE_NOT_BUILT / ENGINE_MODEL_INVALID recoverable.

nodes.statement: On-device inference does not hold the Store mutex.
nodes.ears: WHEN batch transcription runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL release the Store mutex before transcribe_local so other desk reads can lock.

nodes.statement: The worker path matches in-process transcribe and never silent-cloud.
nodes.ears: WHEN transcribe_job runs for CONSULT-001 fixture-replay, THE SYSTEM SHALL match Store::transcribe and SHALL NOT return CLOUD_DISABLED.

nodes.statement: Capture source is only mic, system, or mixed.
nodes.ears: WHEN a capture source is parsed, THE SYSTEM SHALL accept only mic, system, or mixed. Any other value SHALL return SOURCE_UNKNOWN recoverable.

nodes.statement: Source permission copy requires consent and mixed never claims mic-only fallback.
nodes.ears: WHEN source_permission_hint runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL mention consent is still required. Mixed SHALL say it will not fall back to microphone-only.

nodes.statement: Live-ready means a compiled decoder plus a runnable local model layout.
nodes.ears: WHEN the catalog reports a local engine ready for live transcription, THE SYSTEM SHALL require a compiled decoder and runnable local model layout; a Parakeet checksum blob alone SHALL NOT be ready.

nodes.statement: Model import accepts only user-selected local files or directories and never downloads.
nodes.ears: WHEN model weights are imported, THE SYSTEM SHALL validate and activate a local Whisper file or complete Parakeet TDT directory and SHALL NOT fetch replacement files.

nodes.statement: Live audio never defaults to fixture replay and remains retryable until a runnable local engine is selected.
nodes.ears: WHEN a live recording stops, THE SYSTEM SHALL use an explicitly selected runnable non-fixture local engine or keep the encrypted recording recorded with ENGINE_SETUP_REQUIRED.

nodes.statement: Incomplete flushed capture chunks are discoverable only for their consented session.
nodes.ears: WHEN Sotto opens after an unfinalized consented capture has flushed chunks, THE SYSTEM SHALL report that exact session as recoverable and SHALL NOT discard or reassign the chunks.

nodes.statement: Recovered capture is encrypted before plaintext chunks are removed.
nodes.ears: WHEN the user recovers an incomplete capture, THE SYSTEM SHALL persist encrypted audio through normal finalization before removing plaintext chunks.

nodes.statement: macOS judge commands use an isolated test keystore while production desktop keeps Keychain.
nodes.ears: WHEN make demo, make contract, or make ci runs in a macOS test context, THE SYSTEM SHALL use an isolated deterministic test keystore without changing the production Keychain backend.

nodes.statement: Judge commands complete without desktop resources and preserve the offline fixture boundary.
nodes.ears: WHEN make demo, make contract, or make ci runs with cached dependencies, THE SYSTEM SHALL complete without hardware, permissions, model weights, or desktop UI and SHALL keep demo on fixture-replay with zero network calls.

nodes.statement: macOS desktop build claims require current desktop targets, UI, and unsigned app evidence.
nodes.ears: WHEN the macOS desktop is claimed buildable, THE SYSTEM SHALL have current desktop Rust, desk UI, and unsigned app-bundle evidence; Linux core results SHALL NOT satisfy the gate.

nodes.statement: Founder daily-use certification requires content-free live hardware, recovery, encryption, and real-model evidence.
nodes.ears: WHEN Sotto is certified for founder daily use, THE SYSTEM SHALL have current consented mic, system, mixed, pause, recovery, encryption, and real local-model evidence; compile-only results SHALL NOT satisfy the gate.

nodes.statement: Public docs distinguish demo, live capture, model prerequisites, and shipped work.
nodes.ears: WHEN a first user reads product and contributor docs, THE SYSTEM SHALL distinguish fixture demo from live capture and real local transcription and SHALL NOT describe shipped waves as future work.

nodes.statement: Verification claims name their platform and evidence class.
nodes.ears: WHEN documentation claims a capability is verified, THE SYSTEM SHALL distinguish Linux core contracts, macOS desktop build, hardware permission probes, and real-model transcription.

nodes.statement: Apple Speech is an on-device local engine and never a silent server path.
nodes.ears: WHEN apple-speech-ondevice is selected, THE SYSTEM SHALL use on-device Apple speech only; Linux CI and demo SHALL NOT invoke it.

nodes.statement: Parakeet download is user-started, staged, and never part of demo or import.
nodes.ears: WHEN the user downloads Parakeet TDT weights, THE SYSTEM SHALL fetch pinned files into staging and activate atomically; import_local and demo SHALL NOT download.
